title: Normalized affine target edge after restricting to a smaller open
statement: Let f:X -> S be qcqs, g:S prime -> S arbitrary, F quasi-coherent, I,J resolutions, p a natural number, V an open of S, W an affine open of S prime with W<=g inverse V, and D the specified open choices. Put G=tensorPullback(g prime)F, U=g prime inverse(f inverse V), L=f prime inverse W, M=G restricted to L, Q=R^p f prime_*G, and k:L -> Spec Gamma(S prime,W). There is an additive equivalence d from derived module sections of M on L to Gamma(Q,W). It sends the cohomology action of the multiplication endomorphism induced by a in Gamma(S prime,W) along k to scalar multiplication by a. For every class y on U it sends cohomologyOpenRestriction(G,U,L)(y) to restriction to W of D.targetClass(p)(y). This statement involves no scalar-extension chart, coefficient unit map or Ext comparison.

proof.text: Apply restrictedResolutionSections_exists to J and L to obtain the actual termwise restricted resolution and its augmentation-preserving section comparison. This proved theorem constructs the resolution explicitly. Tensor pullback agrees with ordinary pullback by unique left adjoints, so G is quasi-coherent; f prime is qcqs by base change. The ordinary pullback quasi-coherence instance is isQuasicoherent_pullback from WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Tilde.

Form c=resolutionSectionClass(R) followed by the inverse resolution comparison at W. affine_resolutionSectionClass_bijective makes c bijective; AddEquiv.ofBijective supplies d. resolutionSectionClass_map_smulHom supplies its scalar formula.

Apply resolutionSectionClass_open_restriction to f prime, G,J, the opens g inverse V and W, D.target and R. The equality flatBaseChangeOpenEquality identifies U with f prime inverse(g inverse V); its displayed c is exactly D.targetClass.

theorem exists_flatBaseChange_target_open_edge
    {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (p : ℕ) (V : S.Opens) (W : S'.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (eVW : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (D : FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V) :
    let G := (tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F
    let U := (pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    let L := (pullback.fst g f) ⁻¹ᵁ W
    let e : L ≤ U := by
      change (pullback.fst g f) ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ (pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      rw [flatBaseChangeOpenEquality f g V]
      exact (pullback.fst g f).preimage_mono eVW
    let M := (restrictFunctor L.ι).obj G
    let C := RingedSpace.moduleCohomology L.toScheme.toRingedSpace p
    let k := (pullback.fst g f).resLE W L le_rfl ≫ W.toSpecΓ
    let Q := ((pushforward (pullback.fst g f)).rightDerived p).obj G
    ∃ d : C.obj M ≃+ Γ(Q, W),
      (∀ (a : Γ(S', W)) (y : C.obj M),
        d ((C.map (M.smulHom (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(S', W)).inv ≫ k.appTop).hom a))).hom y)
          = a • d y) ∧
      (∀ y : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology U.toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
          ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj G),
        d (cohomologyOpenRestriction G U L e p y) =
          Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE eVW).op (D.targetClass p y))
